best_match.fbbt_definition: Adult uniglomerular antennal lobe projection neuron from the ad neuroblast lineage with dendrites that mainly innervate antennal lobe glomerulus VA6. It is born during the eighth division of the neuroblast ALad1 during embryogenesis (Yu et al., 2010). The axons of these neurons innervate a small area at the ventroposterior edge of the lateral horn. There is one of these per hemisphere, it fasciculates with the medial antennal lobe tract and it is cholinergic (Bates et al., 2020).
